text:
The Full Skywalker Family Story Explained | Star Wars: Galaxy Guide
In this episode of Star Wars: Galaxy Guide, we walk you through the full Skywalker family lore and the Skywalker saga, from Anakin and Padmé to Luke, Leia, and Kylo Ren.

How did Anakin meet his wife Padmé? When did Luke and Leia realize they were twins? Who are Kylo Ren’s parents? Whether you’re a longtime fan or new to Star Wars, this Star Wars lore explained guide breaks down the key moments in the Skywalker family history.

00:00 - Introduction
00:50 - In the Beginning (Shmi, Anakin, Cliegg Lars)
4:44 - The Chosen One (Padmé, Darth Vader)
7:56 - New Hopes (Luke, Leia, Beru and Owen Lars, Breha and Bail Organa)
9:10 - Family at War
11:45 - The Jedi Prince (Ben Solo/Kylo Ren, Rey)
